title: sclarea triloba
intro: Sclarea triloba, commonly known as Vervain or Ironwort, is a perennial plant with a history of traditional use. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and anxiety, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Sclarea triloba are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its calming and anti-inflammatory effects. Traditionally, the plant has been used in herbal medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues.
